title: The Girlfriend
plot_overview: A college literature student falls for a charming young man whose possessiveness gradually reveals a troubling side. As their relationship becomes increasingly difficult, she is forced to question her choices, recognize unhealthy behavior, and confront what love should truly mean.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you prefer grounded relationship dramas with strong women’s perspectives and social themes; Not for you if you want a light, feel-good romance or fast-moving entertainment.
review_summary: Pros: powerful lead performance; relevant social message; emotionally grounded | Cons: slow opening stretch; uneven pacing; limited supporting depth
